name: Dhamma Viriya
aka: Centro de Meditación Vipassana Dhamma Viriya

location.address: Charbonier, Valle de Punilla, Córdoba, Argentina (approx. 9 km from Capilla del Monte)

tradition: Vipassana Meditation as taught by S.N. Goenka
technique: Anapana and Vipassana body-scan meditation, taught in silent, structured 10-day residential courses
teacherAccess: No individual teacher access; courses are led by certified Goenka-tradition assistant teachers who give recorded (audio/video) evening discourses and are available for brief clarification questions.
retreatOptions: 10-day residential courses (the standard, recurring offering); shorter 1-3 day courses; longer 20- and 30-day courses for qualified returning students.
about: Dhamma Viriya is Argentina's second Vipassana meditation center in the Goenka tradition, inaugurated in November 2016 on 22 hectares of donated land in the municipality of Charbonier, about 9 km from Capilla del Monte in the Sierras de Córdoba. The center sits amid mountains, valleys, rivers, and streams in the Valle de Punilla, offering a quiet, natural setting for silent practice. It runs the standard 10-day residential Vipassana course taught in the tradition of Sayagyi U Ba Khin, along with shorter courses and, for experienced returning students, longer 20- and 30-day courses. As with all Goenka-tradition (dhamma.org) centers, courses are held under Noble Silence on a fixed daily timetable and are entirely free, funded solely by donations from past students who wish to give others the same opportunity.
schedule: 10-day courses held on a recurring published calendar under Noble Silence with a fixed daily timetable; periodic short courses and 20-/30-day long courses also offered.
cost: No fees of any kind; entirely dana (voluntary donation)-based, with all teaching, food, and lodging given freely and funded by donations from past students.

pricePerDay.notes: No suggested amount; a Goenka tradition (dhamma.org) course with no set fee.

foodNotes: All meals prepared and served on-site at no charge; vegetarian meals included for the full duration of the course.
workNotes: Old students (those who have completed at least one prior 10-day course) are asked to give some work service (dhamma seva); new students are generally not required to work.
